## Statement-isolated Comparator review unit

- `Erdos249257.ExternalVerification.finrank_totientKernelThroughLevelFamily_eq` — local subsidiary theorem: For every e >= 1, the complete dyadic totient kernel through level e has rational span dimension 2^e + 1. **Boundary:** This does not prove irrationality of the totient series.
- `Erdos249257.ExternalVerification.not_finiteDimensional_span_fullTotientKernel` — local subsidiary theorem: The rational span of the full dyadic totient kernel is not finite-dimensional. **Boundary:** No rationality-to-finite-rank bridge is proved.
- `Erdos249257.ExternalVerification.volume_mersenneAchievementSet` — formalisation of known achievement-set geometry: The base-2 Mersenne achievement set has Lebesgue measure exactly one. **Boundary:** This does not decide whether every infinite-support sum is irrational.
- `Erdos249257.ExternalVerification.irrational_erdosSum_full_support` — formalisation of an existing theorem: For every integer base b >= 2, the full-support Erdos-Borwein series is irrational. **Boundary:** This is the classical full-support theorem, not universal Erdos #257.
